title: Chickpea Masala Bites
description: Crispy Japanese-inspired bites filled with a flavorful chickpea and chana masala mixture.
instructions: 1. Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour and a pinch of salt.
3. Gradually add buttermilk, whisking until smooth.
5. Add chickpeas and mix until coated.
6. If using, add grated cheese and mix until combined.
7. Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot oil.
8. Fry for 3-4 minutes, or until golden brown.
9. Using a slotted spoon, remove bites from oil and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
10. Serve warm, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
